answer.reason: The verses tell of Nadab going up the mountain and seeing God, and of his death for offering strange fire.

clauses.english: went up with Moses and saw the God of Israel
clauses.quote: And they saw the God of Israel

clauses.english: offered strange fire before the LORD and was devoured by fire from the LORD
clauses.quote: offered strange fire before the LORD, which he commanded them not

doubts: EXO 24:9 and LEV 10:1 name Abihu with Nadab; clauses are written for Nadab alone, with the shared deeds kept.
